title: pltfm-sync-rapid-huddle-2026-08-18
content:
PLTFM rapid huddle notes — 2026-08-18
Owners: Priya (notes), Evan (routing), Lina (auth), Omar (quotas)
Attendees: Priya, Evan, Lina, Omar, Sofia (SRE drop-in), Mateo (temp notes)

Purpose: quick sync to surface blockers before next sprint planning; capture short actions and experiment status. Keep it terse — followups in tickets.

SUMMARY (TL;DR)
- Routing: hotfix for pod selection fallback merged, still seeing 5-10% of p50 spikes in eu-west on long requests. Evan to investigate backlog behavior.
- Auth: canary for token-refresh 2.1 started; one failing refresh observed (AUTH-128). Lina to rollback if >0.5% errors across tenants.
- Quotas: new soft-quota plumbing landed for burst windows, need e2e test for multi-tenant eviction (PLT-342). Omar to pair with QA.
- Control plane: KV-cache eviction experiment results look promising (30% token cost reduction for short-seq distribution) but latency tail increased in one config; follow up A/B on rollout config.

NOTES / DISCUSSION POINTS
1) Routing fallback hotfix (Evan)
   - What: fallback to regional pool when local allocator returns no candidate. Fix merged in controlplane repo (PR #788) — reduces 503s but p50/p95 spikes persist for some long-running requests.
   - Hypothesis: backlog batching + slow GPU preemption causing bursts. Could be scheduler bin packing interaction with new autoscaler.
   - Next: Evan to run allocation sampling (5m trace) and attach flame graphs. Check interaction with batching window (default 20ms).
   - Risk: if autoscaler scale-down threshold too aggressive we may see cold-starts. Add metric for cold-start percent by region.

2) Auth token-refresh canary (Lina)
   - Deployed token-refresh 2.1 to 5% of traffic (canary group: dev+alpha tenants). Observed 0.08% refresh failures last 12h, spike to 0.6% in one minute -> AUTH-128 ticket opened.
   - Root cause suspect: race on cached JWKS rotation; introduced a short TTL but missing invalidation path.
   - Short term: disable canary expansion; revert config change in canary if failure rate >0.5% over 15m. Lina to monitor and escalate if rollback needed.

3) Quota bursting plumbing (Omar)
   - New soft-quota add allows short bursts with token-bucket windows. Prototype merged in branch but lacks multi-tenant eviction e2e.
   - Failure mode to test: tenant A bursts then tenant B requests starve due to shared pool. Need clear eviction ordering (LRU? weighted fairness?).
   - Omar + QA (Sofia) pairing scheduled Tues 2026-08-20 to exercise PLT-342 scenarios. Add synthetic tests to CI with 100 tenants, skewed load.

4) KV cache eviction experiment (Priya + Research)
   - Metric highlights: short sequence average tokens/op reduced ~30% with prefix caching + soft-ttl. Tail (99.9) latency increased on config C-3 by ~12ms for >2k concurrent streams.
   - Action: run A/B where C-3 is limited to non-critical tenants for 48h. If tail impact persists, tune cache admission (min prefix length) and fallback hit threshold.

QUICK WIN ITEMS (<=3d)
- Add cold-start percent by region dashboard (Evan) — ticket PLT-355.
- Add invalidation hook to JWKS cache (Lina) — small PR to auth service.
- Add multi-tenant quota e2e skeleton to CI (Omar) — pair with QA.

BLOCKERS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Who owns the autoscaler threshold tuning for Dedicated vs Hosted? (Action: Priya to confirm owner and update ownership doc)
- Are we comfortable expanding KV-cache A/B to 20% if tail remains +10ms? Need eng+SRE sign-off.
- Need clarity on rollout policy: should quotas have tenant-level opt-out during beta? (Product question)

ACTION ITEMS (owner — due)
- Evan: produce allocation sampling + flamegraph, attach to PLT-360 (due 2026-08-20).
- Lina: monitor canary and prepare rollback PR for token-refresh TTL (due 2026-08-18 end of day).
- Omar: pair with QA to create e2e quota eviction tests, open follow-up PLT-342 (due 2026-08-23).
- Priya: draft ownership doc for autoscaler thresholds and assign (due 2026-08-21).
- All: add link to relevant Slack thread in tickets for faster context.

MISC NOTES / Scratchpad
- Quick snippet for sampling command (Evan): kubectl exec -c allocator -- nslookup && curl -s /allocations?since=5m > ./alloc-sample.json
- Lina: note to self — check OIDC provider logs around 2026-08-17 03:12 UTC for rotation events.
- Omar: think about weighted fairness vs LRU for eviction; weighted fairness might be fairer for SLA tiers but more expensive to compute.

FOLLOW-UPS / LINKS
- Control plane PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/788
- Linear tickets: PLT-342 (quota e2e), PLT-355 (cold-start dashboard), PLT-360 (routing allocation trace)
- Slack huddle: #pltfm-controlplane (drop-in recordings)

NEXT MEETING
- Quick check-in Friday 2026-08-21 09:30 PT (15m). Goal: validate whether canary can expand and confirm e2e test status.

END NOTES
- Tone: working doc. Keep adding short updates here before triage to tickets. If something is 'urgent' prefix with [URGENT] in the subject so SRE sees it.
